packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 is the Go port, and it no longer exposes the JS API enums (ts.TypeFlags, ts.SyntaxKind, ts.SymbolFlags, ...) that the type-aware linting stack reads. ts-api-utils dereferences ts.TypeFlags.Intrinsic at module scope, so merely loading @typescript-eslint/type-utils throws and every rule set fails to construct. typescript-eslint caps its own peer range at <6.1.0 for this reason. Lift this once it ships TypeScript 7 support.
